name: Azure IoT Hub
tagline: Microsoft cloud hub for device management, twins, and bi-directional messaging.
description: Azure IoT Hub is Microsoft's managed service for connecting, monitoring, and managing IoT devices at scale. It provides device identity, twin state, direct methods, cloud-to-device and device-to-cloud messaging, plus service APIs for jobs and bulk operations. Developers use REST (and SDKs) against a per-hub hostname under Azure Active Directory or shared access signatures.

auth.details: Shared Access Signature (SAS) tokens via Authorization header, or Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID) bearer tokens; connection strings from hub Access Control.

use_cases: list registered IoT devices on a hub
read or update a device twin desired/reported properties
send a cloud-to-device message to a device
invoke a direct method on a connected device
create a job to update many device twins
